import json,subprocess,sys,collections,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/tests')
from ref import Image

def make(rng):
    ops=[]
    # several TYPE3 hotspots: base of 96..110 bits, then 8..40 children at +6 bits
    for _ in range(6):
        bl=rng.choice([96,102,108,114])
        base=rng.getrandbits(bl)
        n=rng.randint(7,40)
        for i in range(n):
            ln=bl+6+rng.randint(0,10)
            if ln>128: ln=128
            v=(base<<(128-bl)) | (rng.randrange(64)<<(128-bl-6)) if bl+6<=128 else 0
            v|=(rng.getrandbits(128-ln)) if ln<128 else 0
            v&=(1<<128)-1
            v=(v>>(128-ln))<<(128-ln)
            ops.append(['put','%032x'%v,ln,rng.randint(0,4194302)])
    # deep chains
    for _ in range(30):
        v=rng.getrandbits(128); ln=rng.choice([124,125,126,127,128])
        v=(v>>(128-ln))<<(128-ln)
        ops.append(['put','%032x'%v,ln,rng.randint(0,4194302)])
    rng.shuffle(ops)
    return ops
